relationships.subject: FRICT-ION model
relationships.evidence_quote: We first showed that the Cacna1i gene encoding Cav3.3 is significantly upregulated in whole trigeminal ganglia of FRICT-ION mice compared to controls at week 10 post-injury.

relationships.subject: TAT-C3P
relationships.evidence_quote: We demonstrated a significant increase (p < 0.0001, 2-way ANOVA with posthoc Tukey’s test) in mechanical withdrawal thresholds in both male (Figure 1a) and female (Figure 1b) FRICT-ION mice.

relationships.subject: TAT-C3P
relationships.evidence_quote: intraperitoneal injection of a selective TAT-based Cav3.3 blocking peptide in FRICT-ION mice significantly reduces Cav3.3 protein expression at the peak anti-allodynic effect

key_findings: Cav3.3 mRNA and protein are upregulated in trigeminal ganglia 10 weeks after FRICT-ION injury.
Cav3.3 blocking peptide TAT-C3P alleviates mechanical allodynia, more strongly in females.
